reservations.required_gate: Approve the strict capability schema, proof-key and replay bindings, canonical vectors, and local issuer/verifier profile.
reservations.compatibility_rule: The provider-neutral contract and every optional provider adapter use distinct identifiers; admission never changes CuePolicy or recovery-suite bytes.

reservations.required_gate: Approve the revised portable-artifact manifest, allowlist, provenance rules, and deterministic package tests.
reservations.compatibility_rule: Frozen anonymous-artifact v1 and v2 packages remain immutable; later evidence is packaged under a new artifact identifier.

reservations.required_gate: P2.1 v1 allocation required the descriptor, current-pointer, bundle, manifest, trust, limit, and suite-binding profiles with bounded canonical vectors; every later semantic change repeats that gate.
reservations.compatibility_rule: New bundle members and pointers do not reinterpret frozen backup or cloud-object formats; semantic changes require a new epoch and identifier.

reservations.required_gate: Freeze exact suite, topology, authorization quorum, host scope, provider, runtime package, and test matrix.
reservations.compatibility_rule: Same-host, host-separated, independently administered, provider, suite, and threshold profiles are never pooled or relabeled.

reservations.required_gate: P2.1 v1 allocation required strict RecoveryDescriptor and authenticated current-pointer schemas, external trust-root rules, limits, signatures, and canonical vectors; every later semantic change repeats that gate.
reservations.compatibility_rule: A descriptor version binds one suite and epoch and never changes frozen backup, CuePolicy, or Yi formats.

reservations.required_gate: Approve each atomic input grammar, cardinality, canonicalization, ambiguity rule, domain, NoResolver profile, and vectors.
reservations.compatibility_rule: Every semantic policy change receives a new policy identifier and epoch; the frozen composite policy remains byte-identical.

reservations.required_gate: Approve the complete aPPSS suite, password domain, OPRF, field, state, message, wire, error, and fixed-vector schemas.
reservations.compatibility_rule: A suite is immutable and bound one-to-one with an epoch; Yi and aPPSS state cannot mix, convert in place, or downgrade automatically.

reservations.required_gate: Approve exact evidence scenarios, aggregate fields, provenance, metric definitions, positive controls, and result schemas before collection.
reservations.compatibility_rule: New suite and deployment results use separate families; retained v1/v2 evidence is append-only and cannot be pooled or reinterpreted.

reservations.required_gate: Approve the privacy-safe collection boundary, synthetic topology, retained aggregate fields, exclusions, and trace schema.
reservations.compatibility_rule: A changed collection boundary, topology, role view, or retained field set requires a new trace and evidence profile.
